topPRs.title: feat(cci-stats): map flaky test markers to structured statuses
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Add `mapFlakyStatus()` helper that detects `FLAKY_FAIL:` and `FLAKY_PASS:` prefixes in CircleCI test skip messages
- Update `fetchTestMetadata()` to pass flaky-marked skipped tests through (instead of filtering all skips) with mapped statuses: `FLAKY_FAIL` → `"failed"`, `FLAKY_PASS` → `"flaky_pass"`
- Regular skipped tests continue to be filtered out

This enables Grafana dashboards to track flaky test outcomes: failures show up as real failures (matching previous op-acceptor behavior), and `flaky_pass` entries enable querying for tests that have stabilized.

No schema migration needed — `status` is VARCHAR and the existing index covers new values.

Companion PR: ethereum-optimism/optimism#19719 — devtest changes that emit the FLAKY_FAIL/FLAKY_PASS markers.

## Test plan

- [x] New test: `TestFlakyStatusMapping` — table-driven test covering all 6 cases (flaky fail, flaky pass, regular skip, empty skip, regular failure, success)
- [x] All existing tests pass
- [x] `go vet` clean
